st: SOLVED: The Tragic Case of Mengqi Ji
d: When Mengqi Ji vanished, her husband claimed she walked out on him. But cell phone data, muddy boots, and a juniper tree in a state park told a very different story. A solved true crime case about control, lies, and justice.

st: SOLVED: Jealous Wife Kills Her Husband's New GF: The Tragic Case of Michelle Boat & Tracy Mondabough
d: A woman stalks and kills her estranged husband's new girlfriend in broad daylight while witnesses watch. She tried to cover it up, but the evidence was overwhelming. A solved true crime case that is vicious, obsessive, and heartbreakingly avoidable.
Investigate three serial killers who evaded law enforcement. Documentary-style exploration of unsolved cases, evidence, and investigative challenges.
‘Lord’ Edward Davenport a.k.a. “Fast Eddie” is a property developer and convicted fraudster. He is said to have made £34.5 million through his various frauds, with as many as 51 victims.
Brian Goldie passes himself off as a qualified former advocate in the High Courts of Scotland. But he has no legal qualifications and instead is a convicted fraudster.
Nicknamed the “King of Gamblers”, Chia’s story begins with a seemingly modest family man living out a double life of flash cars, and international casinos. Eventually going on to steal $117 million.
For 20 years John Keady has seduced women from across Britain and Europe to America. But to dismiss this man as a serial womanizer would be a mistake; he is a callous and vicious conman.
With smooth talk and promises of massive business deals ‘The Phantom’ has conned people out of millions. We hear from his victims and the private investigator that helped expose him.
David Nepia Carroll was in his teens when he started stealing from his nephew’s piggy bank to more than £30,000 from his grandmother. He has now been in and out of prison 41 times.
Michael Brown is a convicted fraudster from Scotland. Posing as a highly successful bond dealer, claiming connections with the royal family, Brown swindled around £36m out of his victims.

t: The Case: A Predator of the Court (Véronique Béchu)
st: A Predator of the Court (Véronique Béchu)
d: Véronique Béchu has handled hundreds of rape and incest cases. The protection of minors is its hobbyhorse. But the police commander will never forget one investigation.

t: The Case: A French Cold Case
d: The murder of 16-year-old schoolgirl Christelle Maillery, committed at Le Creusot in 1986.
The murder of Mamadou Magassouba, teacher and former boxing champion from Saint Ouen.

t: The Case: The Escape Room From the Baumettes Prison (Pierre Folacci)
st: The Escape Room From the Baumettes Prison (Pierre Folacci)
d: On June 26, 1999, in Marseilles, five prisoners of the Baumettes prison clung to the ropes thrown from a helicopter and took off.

t: The Case: The Last Tango (Bertrand Gelineau)
d: In November 2006, the relatives of Nicole Saada, a woman in her sixties, came to report her disappearance.
After moving to a quiet suburb, "Mary" finds a new best friend in next-door neighbor Jane. But, before long, it's clear that there's something strange about Jane.
When Terri Mendez breaks up with Jose, she doesn't know he's watching every move she makes. When Terri discovers hidden cameras in her bedroom, she realizes there's nowhere to hide.
At first, Karen Welch thinks nothing of the mysterious call she receives on Christmas Eve.

t: Stalked: Someone's Watching: Out of Bounds
d: A friendly nurse offers odd jobs to a struggling man who quickly becomes infatuated with her. Despite her rejections to his advances, the married man will not take "no" for an answer.
Rachel Wilson's marriage falls apart when husband Darrell starts hiring hookers. But when Rachel moves on and finds the perfect man, Darrell erupts in rage.

t: Stalked: Someone's Watching: If I Can't Have You
d: An overachieving teen finds herself in danger after her violent ex-boyfriend becomes obsessed with her.
Alberto Benitez is a successful police instructor in Kingsville, Texas. When he breaks up with his girlfriend, her obsession turns his life into a vicious game of survival.

t: Stalked: Someone's Watching: Twist of Hate
d: When Dawn is ready to move on from her partner, he begins a vicious campaign of stalking and threatening both her reputation and her life.

t: Stalked: Someone's Watching: In the Spotlight
d: A well-respected TV news journalist in San Diego is stalked by a deranged fan who threatens rape and murder if she doesn't follow explicit instructions while on air.
Cleveland, Ohio was a notorious city in the 1930s. The Great Depression had hit it hard. Crime and corruption were rife. And there was a serial killer on the loose.
